name: Bring the Heat AZ 2024

venue.name: Southeast Regional Library
venue.details: Turn left after going through the main entrance and walk straight until you reach the Shakespeare Room.

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BringtheHeatAZ2024#44262-competitor-responsibilities) tab. ### Guest Policy Due to the venue space, we ask that each competitor limit themselves to ONE guest each.
